question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sanitation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanitation **refers to the process of maintaining clean and hygienic conditions, especially in relation to public health. (विशेष रूप से सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य के संबंध में स्वच्छ और स्वच्छ स्थिति बनाए रखने की प्रक्रिया)

 
 
• **Example**: *The city invested in improved sanitation facilities, including waste management systems and public toilets, to enhance public health and cleanliness.*
 
 
 
• It involves measures such as waste disposal, water treatment, and personal hygiene practices.
 
• In the context of the given question, sanitation is the most appropriate term to fill in the blank as it relates to the maintenance of clean and hygienic conditions.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Refinement **refers to the process of improving or perfecting something. (किसी चीज़ को सुधारने या पूर्ण करने की प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Purification **refers to the removal of impurities or contaminants. (अशुद्धियों या संदूषकों को हटाना)
 
• **Contamination **refers to the presence or introduction of harmful or unwanted substances into an environment or product. (किसी वातावरण या उत्पाद में हानिकारक या अवांछित पदार्थों की उपस्थिति या परिचय)
